summary: Full backend + frontend testing of SigFlow email signature app. 21/21 backend pytest passed (auth, settings, upload, GIF generation, employees CRUD, RBAC). Full UI e2e covered: admin login, all 4 nav items visible, Brand Assets edit+save+persist across reload, GIF composer upload/reorder/remove/generate + fetchable hosted GIF (Content-Type image/gif), Employees create+delete (admin protected), My Signature edit + live preview + copy buttons + Outlook guide modal, employee register + role-based nav (only Ma signature) + redirects from admin pages, shared brand assets propagate to employee preview.

issues: Radix DialogContent missing Description or aria-describedby (a11y console warning).

action_items: (Minor a11y) Add DialogDescription (or aria-describedby) to Radix DialogContent in Employees dialog and OutlookGuideModal to remove console warnings.
critical_code_review_comments: BrandAssets.jsx: settings fetch is fire-and-forget with no error/loading toast on failure — consider a fallback. Not a blocker.

server.py `/api/gif/generate` always writes to same path `sigflow/brand/banner.gif`; cache is busted via ?v=version which is fine, but old GIF bytes are replaced globally (as designed for shared asset).
server.py duplicates `save_frames = frames if len(frames) > 1 else frames` — dead expression, harmless.
test_credentials: Admin admin@sigflow.com/admin123 (works). New employees registered per run.
seed_data_creation: Backend seeds admin on startup; verified working.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Backend tests are in /app/backend/tests/backend_test.py (pytest, uses REACT_APP_BACKEND_URL from backend/.env). Run: `pytest /app/backend/tests/backend_test.py -v -n0`. Frontend uses shadcn+radix; always add `page.wait_for_timeout(1000-1200)` after wait_for_selector on pages that fetch settings/profile via useEffect (BrandAssets, MySignature) — the input renders empty then is repopulated from API, so immediate `fill()` may race. GIF preview uses `img[data-testid=gif-slider-preview]` after generation; empty state uses a div with same testid.
rca of the issue: No user-facing bugs. Two initial anomalies in first Playwright pass were test-side timing races (fill before async /settings fetch resolved) — retest with proper wait confirmed correct behavior.
